title: Gulliver's Travels
author: Jonathan Swift
summary: A ship's surgeon makes four voyages to stranger and stranger lands, including one of tiny people and one of giants. Each place holds up a distorted mirror to the manners of Europe.
readIf: you like imaginative travel stories with a savage satirical streak underneath.
skipIf: you want a simple children's adventure; the later voyages are bitter about human nature.

pairings.reason: Another short fable that dresses political criticism up as a strange, simple story.
A modern comic voyage that uses absurd worlds to poke fun at human folly.
An earlier classic of comic travel that also puzzles over where sense ends and madness begins.
